decisions.reason: The finned tube survived the 2019 pruning that removed four of the six 2018 launches, it is a low-cost component close to the firm's core heat-transfer business, and the missing 2020–2021 evidence gives no clear signal that its value has failed, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes stayed prominently presented after the firm cut its other new lines and cost little to keep in a tube-based portfolio, so the evidence favours holding the option rather than abandoning it.
